test_cases.prompt: Our sales team wants us to build a full custom 3D kitchen designer tool for our e-commerce site so customers can design cabinets.
behavioral_assertions: The agent does not immediately recommend Three.js, WebGL, or Canvas libraries.
The agent excavates intent to determine whether customers need freeform 3D drafting or constrained modular configuration with consultation.
The agent separates hard constraints (device compatibility, mobile performance) from soft preferences.

test_cases.prompt: Here is the stack trace from our worker node: TypeError: Cannot read property 'id' of undefined at processOrder (src/order.ts:42). Fix it.
behavioral_assertions: The agent recognizes this is a causal bug with a stack trace, not an ambiguous feature request.
The agent routes to investigation instead of asking requirements questions.

test_cases.prompt: We need to replace our current internal monitoring tool with something better.
behavioral_assertions: The agent inspects docker-compose.yml before asking what monitoring tool is currently deployed.
The agent discovers the actual job (alerting channels, target types, uptime reporting, regional network constraints) instead of immediately suggesting Grafana or Prometheus.

test_cases.prompt: We need to implement a user subscription renewal system with Stripe.
behavioral_assertions: The agent checks package.json to verify if a Stripe SDK or payment adapter is already installed before asking.
The agent identifies that grace periods, retry intervals, and cancellation rules are commercial decisions requiring owner clarification.
The agent presents at most 2-3 focused owner questions with safe defaults rather than a long questionnaire.
